title: Two months of salary unpaid
user_input: I work as a customer support executive at BrightPath Services Pvt Ltd in Noida. My monthly salary is ₹32,000 and it is credited to my bank account by the 7th of each month. I have not received my salary for August 2025 and September 2025, so ₹64,000 is pending. I emailed HR (Ms. Kavita Rao) on 10 September and again on 8 October 2025. HR replied once saying 'cash flow issues, will be cleared soon' but nothing has been paid. I am still working there. I have my offer letter, salary slips up to July, and bank statements.
